diet.title: Meal plan
diet.subtitle: Trimester-appropriate nutrition ideas
diet.disclaimer: General guidance only. Follow your clinician's advice for your own pregnancy.

breakfast.name: Fortified porridge with berries
breakfast.focus: Folate and slow-release energy for early development

lunch.name: Lentil soup with wholegrain bread
lunch.focus: Plant iron with fibre, gentle on a queasy stomach

dinner.name: Baked salmon with steamed greens
dinner.focus: Omega-3 and folate; keep fish fully cooked

snack.name: Yoghurt with almonds
snack.focus: Calcium and protein between small, frequent meals

breakfast.name: Eggs on wholegrain toast with spinach
breakfast.focus: Iron and protein as blood volume rises

lunch.name: Chickpea and quinoa bowl
lunch.focus: Complete protein with iron-absorbing vitamin C

dinner.name: Lean beef or bean stew with brown rice
dinner.focus: Iron and zinc for rapid growth

snack.name: Cheese with dried apricots
snack.focus: Calcium and iron for bone development

breakfast.name: Oats with chia, banana and milk
breakfast.focus: Fibre and calcium; helps with late-pregnancy digestion

lunch.name: Grilled chicken or tofu salad
lunch.focus: Protein without heaviness as stomach space shrinks

dinner.name: Vegetable and lentil curry with rice

snack.name: Dates with a handful of walnuts
